screening_reasoning: A comprehensive review of deep learning multimodal fusion for sustainable plant care; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A survey of deep learning applications in crop planting; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of CNNs applied to plant leaf disease classification; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A survey of big data, machine learning and IoT for paddy rice production; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.

Crop-type classification from fused UAV RGB and multispectral data uses random forest, SVM, KNN, CART and ANN; a whole-field crop-type classification task using non-deep machine learning rather than pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
Plant height and yield estimation from UAV imagery in faba bean uses regression/ML models; a biophysical trait-estimation task, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation.
A GAN predicts root/shoot segmentation masks of Arabidopsis and Brassica lab plants from time-series data; a controlled laboratory phenotyping study without UAV aerial imagery.
A review of precision agriculture and proximal sensing for crop management; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of ML, DL and IoT in agriculture from an Ethiopian perspective; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A comprehensive review of deep learning across the potato production chain; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of AI methods for detecting and classifying weeds, diseases and fruits; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A review of machine-learning and IoT precision-agriculture crop monitoring; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
TLMViT performs plant disease classification on PlantVillage/wheat leaf images; a whole-image classification task in a plant-disease domain, not pixel-level crop/weed segmentation and not UAV.

A synthetic-image augmentation methodology paper validated on crop/weed/soil classification, detection and segmentation (IoU 0.96); it is a field-imaging methods study without established UAV aerial context or a focused crop/weed segmentation benchmark.
A systematic review of UAV-based weed detection methods in crop fields; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.

OverFOMO is primarily an informative/active-sensing UAV coverage path-planning method that uses a deep segmentation model for crop/weed detection, but the abstract reports no quantitative crop/weed segmentation metrics; it is evaluated through a sim-realistic pipeline.
A review of remote sensing, ML and DL for marine oil spill detection and prediction; secondary literature in a non-agricultural domain.
A real-time crop-row detection system built on U-Net segmentation is for a ground agricultural sprayer; crop-row/guidance detection rather than crop/weed segmentation, on a ground platform.

Lightweight CNN models for real-time weed detection and semantic segmentation are deployed on edge devices, using UAV RGB images of corn/soybean fields; MobileNetV4-Seg reports IoUs of 69.9%/76.8%, F1 of 82.3%/86.9% and 44 FPS on a Jetson Orin Nano, fully satisfying UAV crop/weed segmentation with pixel metrics and edge inference.

Real-time crop/weed semantic segmentation (DeepLabV3-MobileNet) on a Jetson Nano reports mIoU 64% and up to 25 FPS, but the abstract describes a robotic/portable platform rather than UAV aerial imagery, leaving the UAV-modality criterion unmet.
A review of real-time edge AIoT for agricultural image classification; secondary literature without a primary benchmark.
A wide-area real-time UAV object-search system performs object detection (suspicious-vehicle search on grazing prairie); an object-detection task in a non-crop/weed domain.

An intelligent animal-repelling system uses edge-AI object detection (YOLO/Tiny-YOLO) to recognize ungulates and emit ultrasound; a wildlife/livestock-domain object-detection task, not crop/weed segmentation.
Edge-AI recognition of myocardial-infarction vital signs on a Jetson Nano is a healthcare application, entirely outside the crop/weed agricultural domain.

Cotton Multitask Learning (CMTL) combines cotton boll detection, pest-damage segmentation and growth-stage classification from UAV images; a multitask detection/classification/pest-segmentation framework rather than explicit crop/weed pixel segmentation.
